description: Caption-less composite figure mixing EBSD-style IPF orientation maps with 3D cellular-automaton simulation volumes; every panel carries a 100 μm scale bar. (a) contains two rows of three maps at 0.9 strain for 950°C_0.1s⁻¹, 950°C_0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(ε_c=0.2) and 950°C_0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(ε_c=0.4): the upper IPF-coloured row prints grain sizes 28.89±3.09, 31.93±2.03 and 37.16±2.26 μm with DRX fractions 95.0%, 94.4% and 96.3%; the lower row shows green recrystallised grains on a dark blue matrix. (b) gives three further IPF maps: 950°C_0.01s⁻¹ at 0.4 strain (65.33±5.30 μm), 950°C_0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(ε_c=0.4) at 0.5 strain (58.22±5.20 μm) and 950°C_0.1s⁻¹ at 0.5 strain (50.53±5.62 μm). (c-e) are each three 3D CA volumes labelled with percentage, strain and average size: (c) 13.0/73.4/98.7% at strain 0.3/0.5/0.9 and 119.27/55.68/31.07 μm; (d) 3.8/15.4/98.2% at strain 0.2/0.3/0.9 and 135.30/115.06/33.77 μm; (e) 76.9/85.9/97.9% at strain 0.4/0.5/0.9 and 68.69/62.10/37.12 μm. The (e) legend defines white grains = matrix, green = first stage (950°C_0.01s⁻¹) and red = second stage (950°C_0.1s⁻¹). The figure shows recrystallisation fraction rising and average grain size falling with strain, with second-stage grains progressively replacing first-stage ones.

subfigures.description: Two rows of three maps at 0.9 strain for 950°C_0.1s⁻¹, 950°C_0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(ε_c=0.2) and 950°C_0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(ε_c=0.4). Upper row: IPF-coloured grain maps with printed grain sizes 28.89±3.09 / 31.93±2.03 / 37.16±2.26 μm and DRX fractions 95.0% / 94.4% / 96.3%. Lower row: the same columns rendered as green DRX grains on a dark blue matrix. 100 μm scale bars.

Three IPF-coloured grain maps: 950°C_0.01s⁻¹ at 0.4 strain (65.33±5.30 μm), 950°C_0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(ε_c=0.4) at 0.5 strain (58.22±5.20 μm), 950°C_0.1s⁻¹ at 0.5 strain (50.53±5.62 μm). All with 100 μm scale bars; no DRX fraction printed.

Three 3D cellular-automaton boxes labelled 13.0%, 73.4% and 98.7%, with strain 0.3, 0.5 and 0.9 and average size 119.27 μm, 55.68 μm and 31.07 μm. Grains are orientation-coloured; 100 μm scale bars on box edges.

Three 3D CA boxes labelled 3.8%, 15.4% and 98.2% with strain 0.2, 0.3 and 0.9 and average size 135.30 μm, 115.06 μm and 33.77 μm. The two low-strain boxes are mostly white matrix with isolated green grains; the 0.9-strain box is almost entirely red. 100 μm scale bars.

Three 3D CA boxes labelled 76.9%, 85.9% and 97.9% with strain 0.4, 0.5 and 0.9 and average size 68.69 μm, 62.10 μm and 37.12 μm. Green first-stage grains dominate at 0.4 strain, red second-stage grains dominate at 0.9 strain. Below it the colour legend 'White grains: matrix  Green grains: first stage(950°C_0.01s⁻¹)  Red grains: second stage(950°C_0.1s⁻¹)' and an X-Y-Z axis triad.

observations.observation: (a) upper row shows three IPF-coloured grain maps at 0.9 strain labelled 950°C_0.1s⁻¹, 950°C_0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(ε_c=0.2) and 950°C_0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(ε_c=0.4), each with a 100 μm scale bar.
(a) prints average grain sizes of 28.89±3.09 μm, 31.93±2.03 μm and 37.16±2.26 μm for the three 0.9-strain conditions (left to right).
(a) prints DRX fractions of 95.0%, 94.4% and 96.3% for the three 0.9-strain conditions.
(a) lower row renders the same three condition columns as isolated green recrystallised grains on a dark blue matrix, emphasising DRX fraction rather than full orientation.
(b) maps are labelled 950°C_0.01s⁻¹ at 0.4 strain (65.33±5.30 μm), 950°C_0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(ε_c=0.4) at 0.5 strain (58.22±5.20 μm) and 950°C_0.1s⁻¹ at 0.5 strain (50.53±5.62 μm).
(c) three 3D CA boxes are labelled 13.0%, 73.4% and 98.7% at 0.3, 0.5 and 0.9 strain, with average sizes 119.27 μm, 55.68 μm and 31.07 μm.
(d) three 3D CA boxes are labelled 3.8%, 15.4% and 98.2% at 0.2, 0.3 and 0.9 strain, with average sizes 135.30 μm, 115.06 μm and 33.77 μm.
(e) three 3D CA boxes are labelled 76.9%, 85.9% and 97.9% at 0.4, 0.5 and 0.9 strain, with average sizes 68.69 μm, 62.10 μm and 37.12 μm.
Colour legend printed under (e): 'White grains: matrix  Green grains: first stage(950°C_0.01s⁻¹)  Red grains: second stage(950°C_0.1s⁻¹)'.
In (e) the 0.4-strain box is dominated by green first-stage grains whereas the 0.9-strain box (97.9%) is dominated by red second-stage grains.
In (d) the 0.2- and 0.3-strain boxes are mostly white matrix with isolated green grains (<16%), while the 0.9-strain box (98.2%) is almost entirely red.
In each of (c), (d) and (e) the printed percentage increases monotonically with strain while the printed average grain size decreases monotonically (e.g. 119.27 → 55.68 → 31.07 μm in (c)).
All 3D CA boxes carry 100 μm scale bars on their edges, and an X-Y-Z coordinate triad is drawn at the bottom left of the figure.
